case_unit_metadata.legacy_patient_keys: Original patient_* keys and legacy aggregation text describe case summaries; they do not establish patient independence.

sampling_unit: 160 shared patches total across all eight cases, not160 per case; four models see the same bank.
strata_interpretation: CT_uniform and three GT-enriched strata remain separate; GT-enriched sampling is not natural prevalence, calibration or CT-only localization performance.

actually_consumed.main_C_concat: null: classifier is not a conditional-composition input
actually_consumed.ablations_A_soft_constant: fixed uniform scale[1/5]*5, structure[1/3]*3; trained classifier predictions unused by conditional arithmetic

definitions.composition_MAE: Mean absolute probability error across classes then patches within case; equal supported case means.
definitions.composition_SSE: Sum of squared class probability errors per patch, then within-case and equal-case averages; not CE, target entropy or calibrated uncertainty.
definitions.fine_or_junction_MAE: Absolute error at scale index1 or structure index2 with the same head-valid masks.
definitions.Spearman: Descriptive within each case/stratum only; all missing values and reasons preserved; no p-values or bootstrap.
definitions.across_head_MAE_or_SSE_not_directly_comp: Different class counts5/3 and target histograms.

saved_score_recomputation: Original frozen score_bank reproduced all512 case-score rows and64 aggregates exactly from saved prediction/target JSON vectors.
offline_evidence_scope: Only collected JSON bytes, vectors, scores and aggregates were rechecked locally. Geometry arrays were not collected or locally decoded/rehashed; author-side completed checks are not recreated by this public package.
